item.title: Why 75% of employed Namibians are stuck in a poverty trap of adult dependants
item.description: More than 70% of working individuals are unable to save money or build generational wealth because of the unemployed depending on them. item.title: Austerity for Namibia’s Working People?
item.description: Despite the theme of Namibia’s 2026 budget, ‘People, Productivity, Prudence’,’ it was certainly not transformational.
